description: Final report of the USDA Forest Service Aerial Firefighting Use and Effectiveness study: 27,611 observed drops at 272 incidents in 18 states, 2015-2018, scored drop by drop against the objective each drop was ordered for. 46 pages.
publisher: United States Department of Agriculture, Forest Service, Fire and Aviation Management

attribution: USDA Forest Service, Fire and Aviation Management, 'Aerial Firefighting Use and Effectiveness (AFUE) Report', March 2020.
notes: The cover title is 'Aerial Firefighting Use and Effectiveness (AFUE) Report' and the date on it is March 2020; 'final report' comes from the filename and the August 2020 posting date, and our prior paper's citation uses the filename. This is the source most damaging to the metric this project publishes, which is why it is stored rather than linked: probability of success was 0.56 for airtanker drops without ground engagement against 0.72 with it, and the modal outcome without ground crews was 'not effective'.
